title: Blocks: lists, quotes and callouts
p: A document is made of blocks. Paragraphs, headings, list items, images and tables are all blocks you can insert, transform or move. Learn these few operations and the rest of the editor will feel familiar.
h1: Three ways to work with blocks
p: Type / on an empty line. Keep typing to narrow the list, use the arrow keys to choose an item, and press Enter to insert it.

img.caption: Type a slash, search for a block, then press Enter

p: The menu includes text, headings, lists, tasks, code, quotes, callouts, dividers, links, images, files, tables, columns, equations, buttons, child-page lists, reminders and countdowns. Try /table, /code, /callout or /countdown.
Hover to the left of a block to reveal its handle. Click it to open the block menu.

ol.li: Turn into: change a paragraph into a heading, list, task, quote, callout or code block without retyping it.
Indent and align: adjust hierarchy and horizontal alignment.
Color: set the block's text and background colors.
Cut, copy or delete: act on the block and its children.
Add below: insert another block directly underneath.

p: On an empty line, the handle becomes a plus button that opens the insert menu.

Drag the handle to move a block. A blue line marks its destination; dragging to the right can nest it under the previous block. Select several blocks to move them together. You can also press ⌃ ⇧ ↑ or ⌃ ⇧ ↓ to move the current block one place.
Type - or press ⌘ ⇧ 8. Use Tab and ⇧ Tab to change the nesting level.

p: A callout combines an icon, a background and optional borders. Insert one from the slash menu or transform an existing paragraph.

callout.p: Tip: use a callout for a useful detail readers might otherwise miss.

p: Hover over a callout to change its text, border and fill colors with the palette control. Click its icon to choose another emoji.
Type --- or press ⌘ ⌥ S. The document theme decides whether the divider is dotted, solid or dashed.
Insert a reminder from the slash menu or press ⌘ ⌥ W. For example, a review could be scheduled for {{reminder:2026-11-09 10:00}}, with a year-end deadline of {{reminder-day:2026-12-31}}.

ul.li: Click the date to edit it. Add a time or use an all-day event.
Choose a notification at the event time or in advance. All-day reminders use 9:00 a.m.
Upcoming dates within a week appear orange, overdue dates red, and later dates blue.

callout.p: Quiet.md must be running to send a reminder notification. Quitting the app stops reminders until it is running again.
